description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named NumberPad, which manages the display and interaction logic for a numeric keypad in a calculator application. It handles localization of digit symbols, manages visual states for error display, and adjusts enabled buttons based on the current number base (binary, octal, etc.).

classes.name: NumberPad
classes.description: A user control for numeric input, supporting localization, visual states, and radix-specific button enabling.

methods.name: NumberPad
methods.description: Constructor initializing localization settings and UI components.

methods.name: OnCurrentRadixTypePropertyChanged
methods.description: Adjusts button enabled states based on the selected number base.
